scripts.validate:toolchain: bun run version:check && bun run lint:biome && bun run lint:oxlint && bun run lint:knip && bun run toolchain:diff
scripts.coverage:check: bun run cli/dev/coverage-check.ts --include cli/dev/coverage-check.ts --include cli/dev/dist-smoke.ts --include cli/dev/generate-version.ts --include cli/dev/release-provenance.ts --include cli/dev/toolchain-smoke.ts --include cli/commands/bootstrap.ts --include cli/commands/project-benchmark.ts --include cli/commands/validate.ts --include cli/services/project-benchmark
scripts.coverage:project-benchmarks: bun run cli/dev/coverage-check.ts --include cli/commands/project-benchmark.ts --include cli/services/project-benchmark cli/tests/project-benchmark-command.test.ts cli/tests/project-benchmark-validation.test.ts cli/tests/registry.test.ts cli/tests/help.test.ts cli/tests/kernel.test.ts cli/tests/operation-context.test.ts
scripts.typecheck:ts7:informative: if bunx --bun -p typescript@next tsc --noEmit --project tsconfig.json; then exit 0; else echo 'TypeScript 7 lane not available or not safe to run locally'; fi
scripts.validate:template: bun run template:generate && bun test cli/tests/template-policy.test.ts cli/tests/bootstrap-template-cleanliness.test.ts
scripts.build: bun run version:generate && bun build --compile ./cli/main.ts --outfile dist/afol
scripts.security:scan:informative: bun run security:deps:informative && bun run security:secrets:informative
scripts.security:scan:required: bun run security:deps:required && bun run security:secrets:required
scripts.security:scan:release: bun run security:deps:release && bun run security:secrets:release
scripts.validate:project-benchmarks: bun run coverage:project-benchmarks && bun run kernel -- pb validate --strict --json && bun run kernel -- pb generate --check --json
scripts.validate:release: bun run validate:toolchain && bun run validate:template && bun run validate:bootstrap && bun run validate:project-benchmarks && bun run coverage:check && bun run build:deterministic && bun run smoke:dist && bun run smoke:clean && bun run validate:security:release && bun run release:provenance:release
scripts.smoke:dist: bun run build && bun run cli/dev/dist-smoke.ts
scripts.smoke:clean: bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; tmpdir=$(mktemp -d); trap "rm -rf \"$tmpdir\"" EXIT; checkout="$tmpdir/checkout"; mkdir -p "$checkout"; tar -C "$PWD" --exclude .git --exclude node_modules --exclude dist --exclude .bun-build\* -cf - . | tar -C "$checkout" -xf -; cd "$checkout"; bun install --frozen-lockfile; bun run build; ./dist/afol --help > /dev/null'
